title: ICAN Graro carbon gravel frameset - the tech keeps coming

takeaways.text: In May 2024 the frame, fork, seatpost and fittings were US$899, plus US$198 for the integrated bar; the box includes an in-frame Di2 battery holder.

Proprietary truncated seatpost with weather seal, UDH, removable front-derailleur mount, full fender mounts and three-position bottle bosses; no chainstay or down-tube protection and no foam for internal hoses were supplied.

Brake mounts were flat with only slight paint on the front upper mount; threads were clean, small overspray in the headset seats, the upper bearing sat a little loose, and the epoxy around the fork-steerer hose hole showed small air bubbles.
Weighed parts (size not stated): frame 1.13 kg, fork 450 g, integrated bar 340 g, seatpost 156 g, headset parts 137 g, seat clamp and seal 29 g, compression plug 53 g.
An endoscope showed clean tube interiors, a bonded one-piece aluminium T47 sleeve and guide tubes for hoses; the fork crown and seatpost top were messier, which the reviewer considers common.

disclosure: The description links ICAN's gravel frameset page; the video does not state how the frameset was obtained.
summary: Unboxing and dry-assembly overview with weighed frame, fork, cockpit and seatpost, paint and cable-routing details, and an endoscope look inside the frame, seatpost and integrated bar.
